questions.question: What does the X gate do to |0⟩?
questions.explanation: The X gate is a quantum NOT — it flips |0⟩ to |1⟩ and |1⟩ to |0⟩.

questions.question: What happens when you apply the X gate twice?
options: The qubit returns to its original state
questions.explanation: X² = I (the identity). Applying X twice swaps the amplitudes twice, returning to the original state.

questions.question: What rotation does the X gate perform on the Bloch sphere?
questions.explanation: The Pauli-X gate performs a π (180°) rotation around the X-axis of the Bloch sphere.
